items.title: UK trading platform Hargreaves Lansdown ends its crypto holdout
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how one of the UK's largest investment platforms, Hargreaves Lansdown, is now allowing retail investors to trade bitcoin (BTC-USD) and ether (ETH-USD) products after regulators lifted a ban last year. items.title: Larry Fink now calls Bitcoin ‘digital gold’ after once calling it ‘an index of money laundering’
items.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF became a record-breaking Wall Street product, but a brutal 2026 selloff showed investors why the asset manager recommends keeping exposure relatively modest.

items.title: BlackRock’s Rosenberg says inflation data key after jobs beat
items.summary: Investing.com -- BlackRock Inc.'s Jeff Rosenberg said Friday that the strong August jobs report puts focus on next week's consumer price index data as Federal Reserve policymakers weigh a potential interest rate increase.

items.title: Risk Assets Can Withstand Fed Rate Hike, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
items.summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, portfolio manager of the systematic multi-strategy fund at BlackRock, says a 25 basis-point rate hike would not be a big issue for risk assets. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance."

items.title: Jobs Report Is More About Inflation, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
items.summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, portfolio manager of the systematic multi-strategy fund at BlackRock, says the August US employment report is much more about inflation and Federal Reserve monetary policy. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance."
